headline: Bacalao De Vieyra
subheadline: Congressman Roberto Vieyra could get himself sick eating enough fish caught aboard his cousin’s boat to warrant being removed from office altogether. Prosecutor General Zoraida Avalos opened investigations following audio recordings published by Panamericana Television showing Congressman Vieyra asking his cousin for $25 thousand dollars in exchange for having sanctions imposed upon his fishing vessel named Ponce II lifted. His cousin recorded him red-handed and the tapes were embarrassing. The crime would fall under trafficking influence charges aggravated due to the fact that the congressman holds a position within the state apparatus and aside from potentially losing his seat in Congress he might face eight years behind bars.
